description:
Here's a description of the line plot, following the guidelines:

The plot illustrates the relationship between epochs and BLEU score for different member sets. The x-axis is labeled “Epochs” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 3.0 with tick labels at intervals of 0.5. The y-axis is labeled “BLEU score” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.35 with tick labels at intervals of 0.05. A blue solid line represents “Regular members”, starting at approximately 0.02 at an epoch of 0.0, decreasing to 0.01 at an epoch of 0.5, increasing to 0.07 at an epoch of 1.0, then increasing to 0.16 at an epoch of 1.5, and finally decreasing to 0.13 at an epoch of 3.0. An orange solid line represents “Members with near-duplicates”, beginning at approximately 0.03 at an epoch of 0.0, increasing to 0.12 at an epoch of 0.5, increasing to 0.26 at an epoch of 1.0, reaching a peak of 0.31 at an epoch of 2.0, and decreasing to 0.28 at an epoch of 3.0. A green solid line represents “Held-out data”, starting at approximately 0.01 at an epoch of 0.0, increasing to 0.08 at an epoch of 0.5, increasing to 0.12 at an epoch of 1.0, and remaining relatively steady at approximately 0.12 to 0.13 from epochs 1.5 to 3.0.
